en.headline: Law Society opens arbitration and mediation centre at former Central office
en.dek: The 30,000-square-foot facility at Wing On House includes three arbitration suites and meeting rooms, with the society planning to offer space to members at half market rates.
body: The Law Society of Hong Kong has opened a multifunctional centre for arbitration, mediation and other dispute-resolution services at its former office in Wing On House, Central.

The 30,000-square-foot premises, purchased in 1997, served as the society’s main office for nearly three decades until administrative operations moved to The Center in April. Deputy Secretary for Justice Horace Cheung Kwok-kwan and other legal-sector figures attended the opening ceremony on Tuesday.

President Roden Tong Man-lung said the Council decided to repurpose the site in response to growing demand for arbitration and mediation facilities and to help practitioners manage high rental costs in the market. The centre contains three arbitration suites, several meeting rooms that can also serve as examination venues for more than 100 people, a lecture hall and a cocktail reception area.

The Law Society plans to rent the facilities to members at half the prevailing market rate. Tong said the former office had witnessed many important milestones for the profession and that the new use would continue to support professional standards and the rule of law.

zh.headline: 律師會中環舊會址改建為仲裁調解中心 周二正式開幕
zh.dek: 永安集團大廈三萬平方呎設施設有三個仲裁套房及多個會議室，律師會計劃以市價一半租金租予會員使用。
body: 香港律師會將位於中環永安集團大廈的舊會址改建為集仲裁、調解及其他爭議解決服務於一體的多功能中心，周二正式開幕。
該物業於1997年購入，曾作為律師會總部近30年，直至今年4月行政辦公室遷往中環中心。律政司副司長張國鈞及多名法律界人士出席開幕儀式。
會長湯文龍表示，理事會因應市場對仲裁及調解設施需求增加，以及協助執業律師應付高昂租金，決定將舊址轉型。中心設有三個仲裁套房、多個可容納逾百人作考試場地的會議室、演講廳及雞尾酒會接待區。
律師會計劃以市值一半的租金將設施租予會員。湯文龍表示，該址曾見證業界多個重要里程，新用途將繼續支持專業標準及法治精神。
